tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma la bsngags pa don rgyan pad+ma dkar po bzhad pa'i rdzing bu bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pā dā ya/ rab 'byams chos kun snyan pa'i glu len mkhan// dran pas ngag gi dngos grub yongs stsol ba// yid 'phrog mtsho byung zla ba gsar pa dang*// dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma la btud nas// rgyal yum sgra dbyangs dbyangs can ngag gi lhar// bsngags brjod don rgyan rgyan 'os pad+ma dkar// tshar du dngar bzhad bzhad pa'i rdzing bu 'di// snyan tshig smra mkhas mkhas pa'i rjes 'brangs brtsams/ dgu pa srid pa can las phyi'i rgyu cung zad dang bcas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ tshon gyis ma bskus rab sngo chu gter 'gram// margad zhun mas bran min spang ljang tshal// bzang drug phye ma ma bkram dri bsung 'thul// gzhan skyon ma mthong dgod pa'i me tog khrod/ nyer brgyad pa skabs min bstod pa ni// zhing der 'phur lding g.yo ba'i rkang drug tshogs// 'dir snang yud tsam bde la khe grags 'byor// 'dod pas lus sems mnar dub dogs med par// sbrang rtsis 'tsho ba'i snang sems bde nyams la// gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan las mtha' dag gi gzugs can ni/ de dbus pad sdong gar mkhan lus phra mas// me tog sen mos spras pa'i yal ga dang*// lo 'dab lag pa'i zlos gar bsgyur ba des// 'dab stong dkar po'i bzhin ras ngom pa'i rtser// so bzhi pa rang spel las gcig brten gyi rab spel ni/ 'o mtsho 'khyil 'dra zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis// bteg pa'i tsog pur zhabs gnyis 'khor lo'i lag /rin chen rkang gdub bklubs tshe gdengs can dbang*// ngo tshas gnam 'phyo'i grong du yibs kyis dogs// dang po rang bzhin brjod pa'i rgyan las rigs rang bzhin brjod pa ni// brang gi logs skyes mngon mtho bcu drug lor// gnas pa'i na tshod dar bab sgeg mo'i sku// blta na mi ngom mtshan dpe'i snang ba 'bum// 'bar ba'i mtshar sdug lha mo dbyangs can ma// gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan las bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/

rgyal gsung gsang ba mi zad chu yi gter// bsrubs skyes snying po mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor cha// gang pa'i yid 'phrog snang brnyan ston dus zla// skal bzang yid mkhar rtag tu bgrod pa mkhan// gnyis pa dpe rgyan las dang po chos dpe ni/ yon bor lta byed dkyus su ring ba'i spyan// rnam par g.yo ba'i sgeg 'dzum zhal gyi khyim// rkang drug khyo shug myos pa'i 'phur lding stong*// bsgyur ba'i 'dam skyes lta bur mdzes shing dkar// gnyis pa dngos po'i dpe ni/ gtsug lag rab 'byams 'chang mkhas mchu yi sgros// 'dzum dbus dkar la thags bzang bzhi bcu'i tshems// pad+ma rā ga'i nags klung nyams dga' bar// zla 'od khyab pa'i ku mud bzhad pa bzhin// dgu pa nang gi rgyu cung zad dang bcas rab tu grags pa'i rgyu bkag nas 'bras bu rang gi ngo bo nyid ston pa'i srid pa can ni/ byed pos ma bdar phra sdem sku yi rked// zla zhun khu bas sbags min dkar mdangs 'tsher// tshon pir rtse yis ma bris rtsibs stong gi /'khor los mtshan pa khyod kyi phyag zhabs mthil// bcu gnyis pa rab brtag gi rgyan las sems med rab brtag ni/ sku yi stod smad sgrib byed gcer las skyob// dwangs gsal g.yo bas mkha' la bag yangs su// rgyu ba'i sprin dkar skyengs te 'dzum pa'i mdangs// 'gyur nas rngul gyi thigs chu 'dzag pa 'dra// gcig pa rang bzhin brjod pa las rdzas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa ni/ gser bzang pā tra 'khyil dbus nor bu'i phra// sna tshogs bkod pa'i sor gdub khong gsing las// 'thon pa'i 'jam mnyen phyag sor g.yo ldem rtser// stong phrag rgyud ldan bai ḍū'i pi wang mdzes/ nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor las chos la bsnyon pa ni/ de las byung ba'i snyan 'jebs sgra dbyangs 'di// lus can rmongs pa las bslang nus pa'i phul// gdod nas grub pa nyid min rgyal kun gyis// legs gsungs chos phung mtha' dag brkus par nges// bcu gcig pa phul byung gi rgyan las khyad 'phags phul byung ni/

'gag med rdo rje'i rang bzhin sgra 'dzin dpyid// mkha' dus grangs mnyam yan lag rdzogs pa'i gsung*// zhing mang rgyal ba mchis so cog gi dbyangs// gcig tu spungs kyang brgya stong char mi 'gran// brgyad pa ldog pa can las gcig gis ldogs pa can ni/ 'gyur khugs snyan pa'i dpal 'jo kun gyi yid// 'gugs byed mgrin pa las skyes tshangs dbyangs dang*// dri za'i rgyud mangs sgra mtshungs khyod kyi gsung*// legs bshad snying po'i 'byor pas tha dad dbye// bcu gnyis pa rab brtag las sems med rab brtag ni/ ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i thugs kyi mtha'// 'tshol 'dod dbang pos 'dren byed stong sprul yang*// ma mngon rang mtshang rdib snyam bsam gtan 'dis// gnyid rmugs go skabs phral ba yin nam snyam// nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa las yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa ni/ bzod dka' tsher ma'i rtsub dang spu gri'i so// rno gdug rang dang mi ldan de lta na'ang*// khyod thugs rnam par mi rtog ye shes kyis// gnyis snang 'khrul pa ma lus dbyings su gtubs// bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa las kun khyab kyi don gzhan bkod pa ni/ shes bya'i gnas lugs ji snyed mkhyen dbyings su// dog med chud la 'gro 'di ya mtshan ci// dus gsum gzigs pas ma gzhal shes bya zhig /logs na med pa rang gi chos nyid yin// bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan las dngos thob kyi dga' ba ni/ gsang gsum byin rlabs zegs ma snying gi dbus// reg pas deng bdag snyan ngag smra ba la// thogs med dga' ba gsar pa 'di ni slar// khyod min lha brgya'i drin las ci slad thob/ bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan ni// dkar gsal mdzes sku 'gyur khugs snyan pa'i gsung*// shes bya'i gnas lugs rjen par 'char ba'i thugs// nya gang ston zla ka la piṅka'i dbyangs// dwangs shel me long gtsang mas yid rab 'phrog /bco brgyad pa nyams ldan gyi rgyan las dga' ba'i 'gyur ba sgeg pa'i nyams ni/

gang gi zhal khyim dran rnams kun dga' brgyas// yid dbang g.yos par ma bzod lag sor bcu// snying gar bcings te spangs rtogs yon tan char// bsngags brjod gtam gyis sa steng 'dar nyams ston// bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can gyi rgyan ni/ sa gsum 'gro ba las rgyal lus med sde// pham mdzad dbyangs kyi rgyal mo'i nus stobs la// dngangs skrag chen po skyungs shig nyam chung rnams// snying rje gting nas 'khrugs pas rjes su 'dzin// bzhi pa gsal byed kyi rgyan las rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed ni/ mkhyen yangs dpal mo khyod kyis 'gro mang gi /snying la nyal ba'i mi shes rmongs tshogs 'joms// chos kun mgrin pa'i lam nas snyan 'gyur ro// brtas pa'i tshig snyan smra ba'i dbang phyug byed// bcu pa bsdus brjod kyi rgyan las spyi tsam gyi bsdus brjod ni/ gdung ba kun 'phrog bdud rtsi'i zegs ma 'bum// 'dzag pa'i kun phan nyid la mi re bar// drod kyis reg pa lan res rnying byed pa'i// me tog gtan gyi mdzes rgyan 'dod 'ga' 'khrul// bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan las zung gi phra mo ni/ skye kun g.yo sgyu 'khyal gtam spangs pa'i las// mthar son sdig sgrib srab pa'i skal bzang 'ga'// mthong tshe mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i mkhrig ma las// g.yer kha gdub sil 'thab pa'i sgra yang ngom// bcu gsum pa rgyu rgyan las skyed byed 'grub pa'i rgyu ni/ gang gis sgrun min thugs rje chen pos 'gror// bcu phrag shes bya rig pa'i dka' gnad brgya// 'grol ba'i shes rab gzungs dang spobs pa sogs// sngon med blo gros bskyed pa'i nus pa rmad// drug pa 'gog rgyan las 'das pa'am byung ba 'gog pa ni/ smra dbang daṇ+ḍī'i ngag kun snyan tshig glur// shar ba khyod gcig drin du sgrogs pa rdzun// 'on te yid la dran pa tsam res kyang*// ngag la 'jigs med mthu ldan byed par nges// bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan las 'os pa'i cha rgyan ni/

yongs kyi blo 'phel ma 'dis rmongs chen 'gro// phal cher btang snyoms bzhag 'di shes bya la// sngon sbyangs yod med mthu las mkhas blun dag /'byung ba rgyu 'bras chos nyid btsan pas yin// bco brgyad pa kun phan gyi rgyan ni/ yang dag don gyi gnas lugs mtshar po che// sgrib byed rmongs tshogs sel ba'i gnyen po zhig /yid la byas tshe rgyal rnams mgrin gcig tu// bsngags pa'i lha khyod sngon las skal bas thob// nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan las bsam pa rgya che ni/ srid na che mtho lha brgya'i do ker tog /zhabs kyis gnon pa'i dpag yas mthu mnga' yang*// thub gsung bshad sgrub byed pa'i blo 'phel grogs// dam bcas rjes dgongs rmongs chen bran la brtson// nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan las tshig tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba ni/ g.yo ldem lus phra'i gar gyis mngon rol ba'i// dkar mdzes mtsho byung smin legs lang tsho can// 'dzum phreng g.yo ba'i khrod nas ngag snyan glu// len pas ris med 'gro la dga' ston spel// nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor las bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor ni/ lho phyogs ma la ya rlung zla ba'i zer// gangs kyi nyal 'gro dbyangs can thugs rje rnams// reg pas gdung ba yongs bcom nus pa'i phul// grags snyan blo ldan skye bo'i ngag las rnyed/ nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan las gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba ni/ de tshe dran dbang tshogs rnams dga' ba brgyas// myos pa'i snyan 'gyur tshig gi glu len tshe// me tog mda' dang gnam ru'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// sa gsum 'pham byed sdug bsngal cho nge 'byin// nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan las smad pa'i zol bstod ni/ sems bral yid bzhin nor 'dis ci 'dod dngos// 'bad med sbyin pa'i mthu stobs cher mnga' na// rang gi khas blangs ji bzhin 'gro ba'i ngor// dngos grub myur mar grags la ci slad bsnyems// so gcig pa lhan cig brjod pa'i rgyan las yon tan lhan cig brjod pa ni/

rin chen rgyan mang 'khrol ba'i sgra dang mnyam// kho bo'i don rgyan bkod pa'i tshig sbyor snyan// mthon mthing ral rtser 'dzegs pa'i zla ba dang*// chab cig go 'phang 'dod pa'i dag snang dkar// nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa'i rgyan ni/ bdag snying dbus su grogs mchog 'jam dpal dang*// lha khyod zag med bde la ci dgar rol// rang nyid gces 'dzin nang shes gyang po ma// gzhan phan sems la 'dzur te logs shig 'gro// sum cu pa nges bstan gyi rgyan las mchog gi nges bstan ni/ ca co'i sgra bcas gaṅgās rdul gyi khur// nyin mtshan khor yug 'dren yang zad pa'i mtha'// med 'dis khyod kyi yon tan rdzogs pa'i grangs// sa bcu'i 'phags pas brjod pa'i yul 'das ston// so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan ni/ des na mi shes rmongs pa'i snying grogs 'dis// ma btang de srid skyon bral me long gzhung*// 'chad pa'i mthu med 'on te ye shes kyi// gzigs pa 'jug phyir don rgyan dper brjod bgyis// so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan ni/ brjod tshul tha dad rgyan mang 'dus pa'i tshig /sdeb legs snyan 'gyur dbyangs kyis mchod pa 'bul// shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun la// thogs med mkhyen pa'i blo gros spobs pa stsol// lnga pa bskor ba'i rgyan las don la bskor ba ni/ tshangs sras lus phra'i mdzes sku yid kyi ngos// nyer bkod dbyangs can dgyes pa'i tshig sbyor gyis// mtsho byung gsang gsum yon tan phung po'i 'char// bstod pas ngag dbang lha mo nyid mtshungs shog /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan ni/ 'chad rtsod rtsom dang lung rigs 'gal 'brel gnad// smra dbang bstan 'dzin sa steng khyab pa'i sdes// nyer bsten rnam 'dren ring lugs dri ma med// srid mtha'i bar du rgyas pa'i bkra shis stsol// gsum pa yang na gzugs can gyi shis brjod ni/ de ltar bstod pa'i legs byas ma dhu raḥ

/ro mchog brgya ldan 'khyil ba'i pad+ma dkar// mkha' mnyam lus can bung bas spyod pa'i tshe// bde skyid rgyang glu snyan po len par shog /de ltar sgra dbyangs lha mo dbyangs can ma la bsngags pa don rgyan pad dkar bzhad pa'i rdzing bu zhes bya ba 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims phun tshogs kyi bka' nan pho nyas bskul bar ma ldog tsam du/ rmongs rtul phran bu shī la rat+na zhes bgyi bas rgyal ba gnyis pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i rgyal tshab kyi skyes bu rim par byon pa rnams kyis gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo ji srid bskal par bskor ba'i 'og min gnyis pa shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon pa zhes grags pa'i ba dan dkar po srid pa gsum gyi rtser snyegs pa'i dben gnas dam par bris pa/ nyes na mkhas la bshags shing dge ba mkha' khyab kyi 'gro la bsngo'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
